import os
services._tabs_scenario_shown = session.Parts.Display
from nx_mcp.kit import parts as kp
path = r'$run\tp\tp_engineer.prt'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
b = session.Parts.FileNew()
b.TemplateFileName = 'model-plain-1-mm-template.prt'
b.Units = NXOpen.Part.Units.Millimeters
b.NewFileName = path
b.MakeDisplayedPart = False
b.DisplayPartOption = NXOpen.DisplayPartOption.AllowAdditional
p = b.Commit()
b.Destroy()
kp.show(NXOpen, session.Parts, p)
result = p.Leaf
